description:
Perpetual futures trades from smart-money wallets on Hyperliquid. Shows leveraged directional bets by sophisticated traders. Use it when the user asks about smart-money perp positions, what high-conviction traders are doing with leverage, or wants to see Hyperliquid smart-money activity.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
